Subjective
Client reported that their mood is better this week and noted returning to morning walks three times this week. Client also mentioned experiencing worry regarding their sick mother, noting that diaphragmatic breathing helps when these worries arise.

Assessment

Client recognizes ongoing stressors related to a sick mother and displays awareness of coping mechanisms, responding well to the practice of diaphragmatic breathing.
